name: BotNotice API
description: BotNotice shows a "you're talking to AI" notice beside a website's chat, keeps a tamper-evident record of every notice, checks consent before AI phone calls and keeps a receipt per call. Plans: Chatbot Disclosure $12.99/month per website; Disclosure + Records $29.99/month per website; Managed Compliance $199/month per website; 14-day free trial on plans with records; no sales call, sign up at https://botnotice.app. The scan and the law dataset need no key. The consent, voice and content endpoints take a per-site token from the dashboard (Voice page for the voice token, Content page for the content-register token). Nothing here is legal advice.
